One year of the Beautiful Destinations Academy…
In partnership with Dubai, the past year has brought together 12 mentors and 18 graduates from around the world to learn, create and tell stories through travel content.
Over the last 12 months, the academy has seen more than 2,000 hours of shooting, 3,000 hours of editing, over 160 locations captured and more than 1,500 stories told.
What started as an idea to help shape the next generation of travel creators has grown into something we’re incredibly proud of. This is only the beginning.
